definition: Implementation Profile of the operation Raster band math (multi-band output), whose meaning is its activity type (activityType): the signature of the Generic Profile Raster band math, bound to data exchange formats.

hasAction.description: The meaning of the operation moves to the activity type https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/raster-band-math-multiband, linked by activityType (gp:activityType). The definition no longer defines the operation; it was: "Evaluates a user-supplied, possibly vector-valued mathematical expression per pixel across one or more input rasters, producing an output raster with one or more bands."

The sources defining the operation move to the activity type: OGC 08-068r2 Web Coverage Processing Service (WCPS) Language Interface Standard; OGC 09-146r8 Coverage Implementation Schema (CIS) 1.1.1, §6.5 RangeType.

The schema copied on each input and output that had one is replaced by the representation that realizes its data type in the data-formats register (decision D6): inputs/rasters -> raster-geotiff (schema was {"type": "string", "contentEncoding": "base64", "contentMediaType": "image/tiff", "description": "GeoTIFF"}); outputs/raster -> raster-geotiff (schema was {"type": "string", "contentEncoding": "base64", "contentMediaType": "image/tiff", "description": "GeoTIFF"}).

Decision D4: tool keywords removed: OTB, BandMathX; 2 format keywords removed from inputs and outputs (inputs/rasters: GeoTIFF; outputs/raster: GeoTIFF); sources removed (tools, testbed, the bbox schema now in the representation's format): OTB BandMathX -- Performs mathematical operations on several multiband images, outputting a mono- or multi-band image <https://www.orfeo-toolbox.org/CookBook/Applications/app_BandMathX.html>; description rewritten without tool, host or testbed. Each removed tool or testbed reference remains findable at tier 4, in bblocks-process-profiles.

The dataType of input `expression` changes from https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/data-types/data-type/string, which hid the concept, to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/data-types/data-type/expression, created for this role in the data-types register.

Description corrected: it said the distinction from raster-band-math (one band or several) was documented only in prose and not structurally enforced; it is enforced since the data type raster-single-band was added (declared 2026-10-08), by the dataType of each profile's output. Decision of 2026-11-09.

Corrects https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/raster-band-math-multiband/actions/band-count-2026-11-09 and the description: the band count is pinned by the const of each profile's schema.yaml; gp:DataTypeReferenceShape only checks that a dataType is a dt:DataType, not which one.

Corrects what https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/raster-band-math-multiband/actions/tools-2026-11-09 describes: the description sections removed then (sources, illustrations, data formats, multiplicity and the open question where present, and the Register position reference to the tier-4 process and its testbed URL) are restored. Tools and testbed stay in the prose; decision D4 applies to the model (keywords, source, properties), which carries none. Decision of 2026-11-09.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-generic-profiles/def/implementation-profile/raster-band-math-multiband to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/raster-band-math-multiband, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/implementation-profile/raster-band-math-multiband/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.
